name: Nedal Haddad
headline: Customer Success Executive | $150M Services | $500M ARR Portfolio | 110% NRR | 30% YoY Growth | Scaling CS & Managed Services | Oracle NetSuite Leader
about:
I am a Customer Success executive with 20+ years of experience at Oracle NetSuite, focused on building and scaling organizations that drive measurable business outcomes.

Most recently, I led a global Customer Success and Managed Services organization responsible for:
 • $150M+ in recurring services revenue
 • A $500M+ ARR portfolio across 2,000+ customers
 • Delivery of 30%+ YoY growth and 110% NRR

My work sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Sales, and Delivery—where retention, expansion, and customer value converge. I’ve partnered closely with go-to-market leadership to:
 • Increase attach rates to 70%+
 • Influence $90M+ in annual renewal revenue
 • Scale Customer Success as a core revenue driver, not a support function

I’ve built and led high-performing teams, developed Customer Success playbooks at scale, and helped organizations transition from reactive support models to proactive, outcome-driven engagement strategies.

At my core, I focus on one thing:
Turning customer value into measurable revenue growth.
